name: Adaptive Bounding Box Computation
definition: Computes a tight bounding box for a 2D Gaussian splat based on opacity threshold, avoiding the wasteful circular bounding box of the original 3DGS method.
summary: Adaptive Bounding Box Computation calculates a tight axis-aligned box for 2D Gaussian splats by integrating opacity thresholds to prune negligible contributions, reducing false-positive tile intersections during rasterization.
